commands.name: list
commands.description: List coding-agent sessions from the runtime registry and the kernel: session, agent, state (live, idle, orphaned, agentless, unrecorded, ghost, undetermined), owner (agent-manager-run, web-console-session, desktop-app, terminal, unknown) and whether the owner is still there, tree, scope, pid, age, claims, frozen. JSON rows add memory_bytes/swap_bytes (VmRSS/VmSwap sums, null when unknown) with memory_status/swap_status, and reapable/reap_reason from the reap policy; summary carries totals.

flags.description: Emit JSON output.

commands.name: reap
commands.description: Stop coding-agent sessions whose owner is confirmed gone (terminal Agent Manager run, archived programmatic web-console session, exited desktop app) through the platform containment seam, with an audit row per stop. Never stops terminal, unknown-owner, idle-only or operator web-console sessions.

flags.description: Only stop sessions at least this old (default 1h).

flags.description: List what would be stopped, with owner evidence, and stop nothing.

flags.description: Emit JSON output.

groups.name: edge
groups.description: Owner-scoped edge routing (per-deployment Caddy snippet, transactional apply and rollback)

commands.name: route-apply
commands.description: Write this deployment's Caddy snippet from a route spec, validate the whole proxy configuration and reload; a failure restores the previous snippet. Also reachable as `edge route apply`.

flags.name: deployment
flags.description: Deployment id that owns the receipt and the snippet.

flags.description: Operation id the step belongs to.

flags.name: step
flags.description: Step id within the operation; one receipt per (operation, step).

flags.description: Operation fence; refused when below the highest accepted fence.

flags.name: spec
flags.description: Edge route spec JSON (schema_version, deployment_id, domain, routes[], snippet, acme_environment). Accepts raw JSON or b64:<base64url JSON> for argv-only transports.

flags.name: spec-file
flags.description: Path to the edge route spec JSON; alternative to --spec.

flags.name: caddy-main
flags.description: Main Caddyfile path (default /etc/caddy/Caddyfile); only the import line is ever appended to it.

flags.description: Snippet directory (default /etc/caddy/conf.d).

flags.name: caddy-data-dir
flags.description: Caddy storage root used to read certificate metadata (default /var/lib/caddy/.local/share/caddy).
